kind: E024 prospective oral measured-depth information comparison
hypothesis: Independent measured per-contig abundance can improve Oral retrieval and recovery with E019 learning fixed; between-community contrast does not identify depth causally.

reference.oral: provided-origin oracle, not unique sequence; known-shared sensitivity unchanged

fixed.encoder: Retained E019 sequence-only context encoder and exact native unit vectors
fixed.DNA: All 1,286,547 contigs / 1,669,981,123 bp plus explicit original two 0 bp input records
fixed.downstream: Exact E023 hierarchy/condensation/density antichain and cached physical-marker weighting; retained density-only alternative
fixed.baselines: Retained E023 oral and E019 scalar/target/geometry summaries; no refit/rescore

treatment: One grouping-only depth rebind plus native 30 / sequence 60 / observed-depth 60 candidate union with unchanged composite reranking. No-depth delegates exactly to E023. No score router.

coverage.mapper: strobealign 0.17.0 existing E009 binary, paired interleaved; -N 0; actual SAM alignments, not --aemb
coverage.index: One new owned reference copy and reusable STI, first 500 pairs uniform 100–500 bp profile; full-stream read lengths must match
coverage.filters: MAPQ >= 20 and != 255; exclude 0xF04; no proper-pair requirement; BQ 0; M/= /X; no D/N/I/S/H/P contribution
coverage.overlapping_mates: Count both aligned read bases; not fragment depth
coverage.denominator: Full original contig length including uncovered and ambiguous positions; no edge trimming
coverage.zero: All matrix cells measured, never imputed; zero rows retained; E023 at-least-one-positive mask omits uninformative all-zero pairs from depth contrasts
coverage.variance: None. Column std across contig means is a transform, not a measured per-base/window variance
coverage.E009_difference: Accepted E009 used MAPQ0/no edge or overlap trimming. E024 MAPQ20 is a new prospective oral policy, not a matched mapping-filter ablation.

data_plan.pilot: Complete first sample 6 acquisition/index/mapping/summary is the native pilot and is never repeated. 1.5 x byte-scaled remaining acquisition + mapping estimate plus 3 h comparison/collection must fit remaining original 36 h.
data_plan.reads: Serial one 5.17 GB object at a time, publisher segment MD5 + new whole SHA256/MD5, complete gzip/paired/multiset-primary identity counts
data_plan.intermediate_policy: Retain exact unfiltered primary emitted SAM as streamed, lossless unsorted BAM in existing private GCS; full byte/readback/decode proof before new raw FASTQ release. Scientific means/filters unchanged; no local BAM/SAM/sort spool.

metrics.primary: Conservative duplicate-safe source-union R95 / all 799 provided targets / 2,083,072,211 bp, separately named provided-origin oracle; known-shared sensitivity unchanged
metrics.keep: All operational/axis/source/resource contracts pass; selected R95 >= 0.07007729606498985 (E019 + 0.005), target-50 >= 43 and target-90 >= 33
metrics.modify: Other valid mixed results or improved information without joint recovery criteria
metrics.abandon: Selected R95<=0.04093190555264913 (E023), target90<=10 and bp-weighted same-origin composite-neighbor gain<=0; abandon this frozen retrieval policy, retain measured data and product depth option
metrics.practical: These are scoped engineering/development effect criteria, not significance or biological standards; do not retune after outcomes
metrics.diagnostic: Full target table and all length/origin/eligibility/marker/status/zero/non-target/unknown/unassigned populations; fixed E019 geometry distinct from new composite retrieval; same eligible-attributable query population

secondary.completeness: Dominant-origin duplicate-safe source union / full provided reference length
secondary.contamination: Confirmed foreign-origin bp and unresolved bp separately; 1-confirmed all-bin purity is an upper bound
secondary.other: high impurity or unresolved; non-target bins reported separately

truth: Provided origin is not unique source. Full 799 denominator, quarantine and shared sensitivity unchanged; original E009 156 / 3.3034% N quarantine is retained context, not rescored.
unchanged_skin: 610 targets / 313 exact oral overlaps unscored; sample/source/genome/replicon/molecule/host/circular/taxonomy/near/pretraining/competitive/unique-versus-origin/evaluator/depth/cost dependencies remain.
